layers.title: Slick and mangrove reference outlines
layers.summary: Red traces the independent slick interpretation about 39 minutes later. Orange traces inventoried mangroves. Dotted blue traces 49 exposed-water cells inside mapped mangrove habitat in the independent optical image taken 42 hours 33 minutes before radar. Coastal tides can change between observations. The NISAR oil screen assessed 172 of 46,942 reference cells and flagged zero.

classes.label: Optical exposed water inside mapped mangrove habitat

layers.title: Exposed water agreed by radar and optics
layers.summary: The October radar screen and same-day optical reference agreed on 3,488 exposed-water cells in withheld blocks here. It also flagged 4,209 cells the optical reference classified as other surface. The outlines show agreement only.

layers.title: Atanasovsko Lake · later optical reference
layers.summary: The dashed outlines trace 1,477 cells classified as exposed water in an independent optical image 16 hours later. All radar cells failed the frozen model’s noise check.

layers.title: Eugene Island · NOAA comparison
layers.summary: NISAR recorded darker water in 362 of 1,730 assessed cells in the independent outline. RADARSAT-2 passed 43 minutes later. Solid lines and the GeoTIFF show the 362 agreement cells in this map crop. The material is unconfirmed.

classes.label: Measured dark water matching the outline

layers.title: Eloi Bay · later NOAA boundaries
layers.summary: The dashed boundaries come from NOAA’s Landsat 8 observations more than five hours later. Parts extend beyond the measured radar crop. Moving water and possible slick drift limit position comparisons across this gap.

evidence.title: Falcon Eye · later slick outline
evidence.notes: Outline was registered against independent Sentinel-1D radar. It shows a later observation and can move between passes.

evidence.title: Curuai · independent exposed-water check
evidence.notes: Independent same-day optical proxy for exposed water, acquired 4 h 51 min 29.899 s after the radar scene. The 60 m grid and scope apply to the outlines. Field confirmation, inundated vegetation and attribution of flood or drought were not tested.

evidence.title: Atanasovsko Lake · later optical water reference
evidence.notes: The optical measurements were made 16 hours after NISAR. The frozen Curuai model withheld the radar cells because the background instrument noise was too high for its cutoff.

evidence.title: NISAR · test of measured dark water
evidence.notes: The observed-HH rule compares each cell with open water on both sides. Oman alone set the cutoff. This test has no pixel-level noise calibration for oil material.

evidence.title: Khor Al Beidah · exposed water inside mapped mangrove habitat
evidence.kind: Independent optical water and static habitat overlap
evidence.notes: Dotted blue traces 49 exposed-water cells inside mapped mangrove habitat in the independent optical image taken 42 hours 33 minutes before radar. Coastal tides can change between observations. The optical proxy requires Sentinel-2 scene classification and the spectral water index to agree in at least eight of nine native 20 m samples per 60 m cell. The inventory depicts habitat.
